title: Ellsworth radar-jet chase and Bismarck lights
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ellsworth radar-jet chase and Bismarck lights, about August 5, 1953 at Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota and Bismarck, North Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota and Bismarck, North Dakota

tellings.quote: On August 5th, 1953, a trained civilian spotter calls into the base.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a case from Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, drawing on the account of Edward J. Ruppelt. In his telling, on August 5, 1953, a trained civilian spotter called Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, which led to jets chasing something seen on radar, and lights were also reported over Bismarck, North Dakota. If true, it would be an unknown object picked up both by eye and by instruments.
